# helper for pagination
def full_search_users(query):
    out=[]
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        r = apis.venmo.search_users(access_token=venmo_access_token, query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not r:
            break
        users = r.get('users') if isinstance(r, dict) else None
        if users is None:
            users = r.get('results') if isinstance(r, dict) else None
        if users is None:
            users = r.get('data') if isinstance(r, dict) else None
        if users is None:
            users = r.get('items') if isinstance(r, dict) else None
        if users is None:
            users = r if isinstance(r, list) else []
        if not users:
            break
        out.extend(users)
        page_index += 1
    return out

        if reqs is None and isinstance(resp, dict):
            reqs = resp.get('sent_payment_requests') or resp.get('results') or resp.get('data') or resp.get('items')
        if reqs is None:
